item.title: UK prime minister signals the government will consider an apology for its role in the slave trade
item.description: U.K. Prime Minister Andy Burnham says his government will consider apologizing for the first time for its role in the trans-Atlantic slave trade as it seeks to strengthen relations with nations in Africa and the Caribbean.
